race.comment: THE WILDLING (9) is the horse to beat, boasting a solid campaign highlighted by a close second to Centimetre at Goulburn, and a decent fifth at Kembla Grange most recently. Guymer hops back aboard and the drop back to country level is a big tick. Can get the job done this time. SUCCESSFUL IMPACT (4) has significant upside, returning for Ciaron Maher following a debut fourth at Hawkesbury, where she was bumped and raced keenly on heavy ground. Two trials since provide a solid foundation for improvement. MISS BINMAN (3) has been racing over further but comes back in trip and class today off a freshen. Not out of this. ROY KELTON (1) was solid on resumption here and this looks to shape similarly. Can build on the fesh performance.
